description: Decision record (DR) — records an architectural or process decision. Spec backlink: pln-qffs-tc-1-records-consolidation-9668e7 § D3, § D4

deciders.description: List of people or agents who made this decision.

superseded_by.description: Path or identifier of the decision that supersedes this one.

context.description: Context or background for the decision.

driver.description: Primary driver or motivation for the decision.

id.description: Canonical DR number string, e.g. 'DR-042'. Dominant spelling; do not use decision_id in new records.
